notes.title: Signal: Uncharted Lands at the VISUAL NOVEL FEST
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that our visual novel [b]Signal: Uncharted Lands[/b] will participate in the Visual Novel Festival, which will take place from [b]March 3 to March 10.[/b]

The official release of the game is on[u][b] March 4[/b][/u], and to celebrate, there will be [u][b]a 15% launch discount[/b][/u]. Add Signal: Uncharted Lands to your wishlist so you don’t miss the release and can take advantage of this special offer!

In the game, you will immerse yourself in a mysterious post-apocalyptic world, where you will embark on a journey with a group of quirky dogs to uncover the origins of a strange signal. Expect thrilling adventures, choices that affect the story, puzzles, quizzes, and plenty of references and Easter eggs.

Don’t miss the chance to be part of this incredible adventure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198561/8fef417ee49eba3b58b565792f3934cc880f208c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Fun Facts About the Characters and Their Actors!
notes.content:
[b]Sergeant Stubby – Little Mia[/b]
Mia is a miniature type of Chihuahua. Because of this, Sergeant Stubby is the smallest character in the game. However, her bravery far outweighs her size. She is always ready to take risks to protect the whole team. Her name comes from historical sources—Sergeant Stubby was a real dog who fought in World War I. He served for 18 months, participated in 17 battles, and took part in four offensive operations on the Western Front.

[b]Dobby – Dobby[/b]
This character's name wasn’t changed because it fits him perfectly, both in real life and in the game. He is a friendly, sociable dog with an unstoppable love for socks. In real life, he has his own special pair of socks, where I sometimes hide treats. Dobby always manages to find them—he has never failed this mission! :)

[b]Mr. Buggles Purrington III (Bug) – Pyrizhok (Zhuk)[/b]
The character Buggles Purrington III was inspired by our cat. Pyrizhok, just like his character in the game, loves when someone brings him treats. Pyrizhok lived on the streets for a while and had to find food on his own, but after we took him into our family, he became somewhat lazy and now prefers a cozy nap.
Does Pyrizhok have magical abilities, just like his character in the game? Well... I can tell you that whenever I pour food into his bowl, Pyrizhok can magically make it disappear faster than I can blink! :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198561/e1d2348b884423568b3edef85627b9ab772ad7e1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Playing together with the lead actor!
notes.content:
Dobby is the main character of the charming visual novel "SIGNAL: Uncharted Lands."
But he’s not just a game character! Dobby is a real-life little dog who became the inspiration and prototype for this hero.

You might say that dogs don’t play video games. And if they do, surely not visual novels… Well, it looks like Dobby is the world’s first visual novel-playing pup!

Join the stream to hear Dobby’s thoughts, impressions, and commentary on "SIGNAL: Uncharted Lands"!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198561/be2f9706276f90c340b431c1afd57fe72d024150.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Signal: Uncharted Lands — nominee of Indie Cup Ukraine’24
notes.content:
Signal: Uncharted Lands — our first game published on Steam, has become a nominee at Indie Cup Ukraine’24! This is an incredible event for us, as just being nominated is a huge achievement.  

It’s a great honor and an amazing source of inspiration to keep working on new projects. Thank you all for your support!  

We can’t wait for you to dive into the world of our game.  

The release is just a few months away — stay tuned for updates!

notes.title: Dobby in real life
notes.content:
[h2][b]
The character in the game and the original Dobby[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198561/8314fd5b446d78ea9c5e915fb399dd9b97836c31.jpg[/img]

Why is this little dog named Dobby?
It's  simple. I love the Harry Potter universe and books. And when Dobie (the dog) was a small puppy, his ears and eyes were disproportionately large compared to his head. And he  resembled the character of Dobby from the movie about Harry Potter. And he really likes to steal my socks ːsteamsadː

His clothes look familiar
So it is! There are a lot of references and easter eggs in our game. Dobby's outfit is also a reference to one great cartoon series. Which one? You have to guess it yourself ːsteammockingː


Does he really like veggie sausages?
And although Dobby eats regular meat dog food, he loves vegetables and fruits very much. Especially peas and pea sprouts ːsteamhappyː
